text: The factory takes every change, and a whole PRD. Today coding agents build Invariant's plumbing in sessions, outside the factory, as D-0048 splits the work. @gitdek wants every change to go through Invariant, and the goal he and friends set is to hand it a full PRD. A plumbing issue goes through the same flow as a modeled one: its proposal is a plan with acceptance tests, ratified by its hash, and its checks are CI's tests, the decision graph and a second agent's review. A plumbing pull request changes only the files its plan names, and only a person merges the trusted base. /invariant plan turns a PRD into a plan of issues, which @gitdek ratifies, and the factory opens and works them one at a time. Recommended: option A, the factory merges plumbing outside the trusted base, plans of at most 10 issues, and slice 13 right after the MCP decision tools.
